# Copilot / coding-agent install

If the user pasted this repository's git URL, the GitHub Pages site, or asked to install or open DeepSeek Harness, follow [INSTALL.md](../INSTALL.md) (Chinese: [INSTALL.zh.md](../INSTALL.zh.md)). The git URL alone is enough. Clone `https://github.com/chenrenhan91-art/deepseek-harness-easy`, not a github.io URL. On macOS finish with `pnpm run desktop:install` from that clone so the Desktop icon and Web workbench window appear; do not stop after clone or build. Do not tell them to double-click a GitHub Release `启动 DeepSeek Harness.command` or a downloaded `.app`. Do not `git add` or push files produced on this machine after install (`.env`, keys, HTML pages, `lib/`, `dist/`).
